title: Commit rule: tie review adoption to a review pair with no unfixed Medium-or-higher finding in that same contribution
outcome: The review-adoption passage can't be read as letting a recommitted contribution adopt a review whose Medium-or-higher finding was fixed only in some later, different candidate.
acceptance: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/commands/review-changes.md say that adoption needs a candidate whose own review pair left no in-scope Medium-or-higher finding unfixed in that same contribution, through the authority-text process (a), (b) and (c)
The wording only narrows the rule and adds no mechanism, condition, proof format or gate
